🚨 The new docuseries 'Michael Jackson: The Verdict' was released yesterday, revisiting one of the most controversial periods of Michael Jackson’s life, his 2005 trial. The three-part series has sparked major debate, with The Breakfast Club 'How much do you hate the doc'? 👀🎤 Tap in and let’s discuss ⬇️

Video

🚨 @latto opens up about why she decided to put her beef with Ice Spice behind her and explains where things stand with Cardi B after the leaked audio surfaced of Cardi mentioning her name in a dismissive way and her tweeted apology 👀🎤. Tap into the full conversation on @netflix

Video

🚨 @latto stopped by to promote her new album, 'Big Mama,' and got candid about why she’s choosing to open up more these days. Latto reflects on the parts of her life she once kept private and why she’s now embracing a more transparent chapter including her love life! 👀🎤

Video

🚨 @latto stopped by to promote her new album, 'Big Mama,' and got candid about why she’s choosing to open up more these days. Latto reflects on the parts of her life she once kept private and why she’s now embracing a more transparent chapter including her love life! 👀🎤

Video

🗣️ @Latto  will be live on The Breakfast Club discussing her new album 'Big Mama', life as a new mommy & more! ! Listen live ➡️ breakfastclubonline.com/list… or stream live on @netflix  tomorrow!

Video

Megan Thee Stallion dropped a snippet of her new song, and it highlights how “that wifey 🤬 is dead”! The Breakfast Club weighs in on why women shouldn't play “wifey” without the ring. Let's discuss ⬇️💍👀

Video

🚨 Donkey of the Day goes to a man who decided to excavate his marital home while his wife and children were inside 😳. All while he was drunk and upset that she wanted a divorce! 🫠
Tap in as @cthagod breaks it down in #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC.

Video

Mayor Mamdani signs an executive order repealing bedtimes during the NBA Finals. Some parents, like @cthagod and @djenvy, aren't feeling it. 🤣

Video

Tyler, The Creator opens up about why he turned down a record deal from Jay-Z and why he doesn’t care about not being a part of the "Top 5" discussions 🎤👀. Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa

Video

The 2026 iHeartRadio Festival is out! VEGAS, HERE WE COME 🥳 This year it’s stacked with some of the biggest names in music! #iHeartFestival

ℹ️All details: iHeartRadio.com/Festival

Video

🚨 @Jeezy  weighs in on the current state of conflict resolution in hip-hop, explaining how some artists have lost sight of the music and are creating violence instead of art. The Snowman ⛄️ makes it clear that the violence referenced in his music was rooted in retaliation and not starting the conflict. Tap in on @netflix

Video

🚨 @jeezy pulled up to promote his upcoming Las Vegas residency, and we took a deep dive into the life of the Snowman ⛄️. From surviving the streets to embracing healing and personal growth, Jeezy opens up about this new chapter in his life and what healing means to him today. Tap in for the full conversation on @netflix ! 🎙️

Video

🗣️ @Jeezy will be live on The Breakfast Club discussing his upcoming 'The Legend of the Snowman' Las Vegas residency and more! Listen live on The Breakfast Club tomorrow! ➡️ breakfastclubonline.com/list…

Video

🚨 @marlonwayans breaks down why Shawn isn’t the Wayans brother to play with! Marlon explains what happened between Shawn and Aries Spears during their interview and why he didn’t come to The Breakfast Club to promote 'Scary Movie'. 👀🎙️🔥

Video

🫏 Donkey of the Day goes to 64-year-old Rick Chow of North Carolina, who was found "not guilty" after the fatal shooting 🔫 of a 14-year-old boy. Tap in as @cthagod breaks it down in #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC.

Video

🚨 Daphne Joy speaks out after the release of an alleged leaked sex tape involving her, Diddy, and an escort. She has since taken to IG Live to answer questions all but one 👀 Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa.

Video

🚨 An alleged leaked audio has surfaced of Sauce Walka has gone viral, in which he allegedly threatens Drake while talking to his baby mother during a heated argument. @lorenlorosa has the latest. 🔊

Video

🚨 The internet went crazy after Jay-Z hit the stage with a new fro, and people began speculating that his afro was a wig! Well, @luckylettty breaks down how, with the use of Cécred products, he was able to take down his locs and transition to a braid-out so quickly with his own hair. Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa 👀💇🏾‍♂️🔥v
